rca_of_the_issue.original_bug: User reported 'Output is still not showing on war room and AI hub' with 'Analysis failed' errors
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: On deployed environments, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (baked at build time) may point to preview domain instead of deployed domain, causing CORS/cookie issues. Also, expired JWT tokens were not being auto-refreshed.
fixes_applied: 1. Added auto-refresh for expired JWT tokens in authFetch - on 401, attempts silent token refresh then retries request
2. Improved error handling for non-JSON proxy errors (502/504) - retries with exponential backoff
3. All frontend API calls now use getApiBase() utility which returns window.location.origin when env URL differs from page origin
rca_of_the_issue.verification_status: All fixes verified working. No 'Analysis failed' errors observed. All AI features return correct data.
